Arabic Language Exhibition for kids

This exhibition is one of its kind in the Arab world to be developed by a language institution, focuses on developing children's linguistic awareness of the Arabic language. King Salman Global Academy for Arabic Language has adopted strategies for building attitudes and values ​​within the exhibition, avoiding overwhelming children with linguistic information. This aims to create an emotionally rich experience for visitors, fostering a positive attitude toward the Arabic language and the nation that celebrates it at the exhibition.

International Falcon Breeders Auction

The Saudi Falcons Club presents the International Falcon Breeders Auction, an event dedicated to promoting the heritage of falconry in Saudi and bringing together elite falcon breeds from around the world. Falcons are showcased in dedicated pavilions, alongside a live auction platform where attendees can participate in competitive bidding in the presence of falconers and enthusiasts. The auction also serves as a trusted platform for the exchange and acquisition of falcons, with its activities broadcast on television channels and live streaming platforms, extending the event’s reach locally and internationally.

LEAP 2026

LEAP 2026 marks the fifth edition of Saudi’s flagship global technology and innovation event, cementing its position as one of the world’s most influential platforms for digital transformation. Taking place in Riyadh from August 31 to September 3, 2026, LEAP brings together technology leaders, startups, investors, policymakers, and innovators from around the world. What began as a bold Saudi initiative has evolved into a globally recognized meeting point for ideas shaping the future. Across four days, LEAP explores breakthroughs in artificial intelligence, fintech, smart cities, sustainability, space, health tech, and emerging technologies, placing Riyadh at the center of global innovation conversations. With thousands of international speakers, hundreds of exhibitors, and tens of thousands of attendees, LEAP’s fifth edition reflects both scale and maturity, showcasing how Saudi continues to drive collaboration, investment, and future-focused thinking across industries.

FIBO Arabia 2026

FIBO Arabia 2026 returns to Riyadh from September 8 to 10, bringing together the latest developments in health, fitness, and nutrition under one roof. The exhibition will take place at Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center, transforming the venue into a hub where leading brands, industry experts, and the latest innovations meet with thousands of visitors from around the world. The exhibition reflects the rapid growth of Saudi Arabia’s health and fitness sector, building on the success of its previous edition, which welcomed more than 12,000 visitors from over 40 countries. This year, FIBO Arabia returns on a larger scale, offering a wider range of experiences for those passionate about fitness, wellness, and healthy living.

Saudi International Falcons & Hunting Exhibition

The Saudi International Falcons and Hunting Exhibition is one of the largest events dedicated to falconry and hunting in Saudi and globally. It brings together everything related to falconry and outdoor excursions, from falcons and hunting tools to equipment and gear associated with hunting trips, all within a comprehensive space that allows visitors to explore this field in one place. The exhibition also features platforms showcasing a wide range of brands, alongside accompanying activities and events suitable for families, creating an experience that blends cultural and entertainment elements. The event plays an important role in preserving falconry heritage and raising awareness by offering content that introduces visitors to its history and significance within Saudi’s cultural identity.

Saudi Falcons Club Auction

The Saudi Falcons Club organizes an annual auction dedicated to locally caught falcons, known as “Al Tarh falcons,” which are captured during the hunting season. The auction is a structured platform that brings falconers together to showcase their falcons in a competitive live bidding environment, enabling reliable buying and selling. The event is broadcast on television channels and digital platforms. The club also provides integrated services for falcon owners, including transportation to the auction venue, along with facilities that organize and enhance the participation experience, all within a framework aimed at developing falcon auctions in Saudi. The auction also contributes to raising awareness about preserving falcon breeds by regulating sales and emphasizing the protection of endangered species.

The Global Water Innovation Award (GPIW) is run by the Saudi Water Authority and brings together a top bunch of innovators, researchers, entrepreneurs, and experts from all over the world.
